planets.name: Mercury
planets.atmosphere: Minimal (trace amounts of oxygen, sodium, hydrogen)
planets.description: The smallest planet in our solar system and the closest to the Sun. It has no atmosphere to retain heat, resulting in extreme temperature variations.
facts: Mercury is the fastest planet, orbiting the Sun in just 88 days
It has a highly eccentric orbit, varying from 29 to 43 million miles from the Sun
Despite being closest to the Sun, Venus is actually hotter due to its thick atmosphere

planets.name: Venus
planets.atmosphere: Thick with carbon dioxide (96.5%) and nitrogen (3.5%)
planets.description: Venus is often called Earth's twin due to its similar size. It has a thick, toxic atmosphere that traps heat, making it the hottest planet in our solar system.
facts: Venus rotates in the opposite direction to most planets (retrograde rotation)
A day on Venus is longer than its year (243 Earth days vs 225)
Surface pressure is 90 times greater than Earth's

planets.name: Earth
planets.description: Our home planet and the only known place in the universe with life. It has liquid water, oxygen, and a magnetic field protecting from solar radiation.
facts: Earth is the densest planet in the solar system
It's the only planet not named after a Greek or Roman god
71% of Earth's surface is covered by water

planets.name: Mars
planets.description: Known as the Red Planet due to iron oxide on its surface. Mars has the largest volcano and canyon in the solar system - Olympus Mons and Valles Marineris.
facts: Mars has seasons like Earth, but they last twice as long
Olympus Mons is 3 times taller than Mount Everest - the largest volcano in the solar system
Mars may have harbored liquid water in the past

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.description: The largest planet in our solar system. Its famous Great Red Spot is a giant storm that's been raging for at least 350 years. Jupiter has a strong magnetic field.
facts: Jupiter is so large that all other planets could fit inside it
The Great Red Spot is a storm larger than Earth that has been active for over 350 years
Jupiter rotates faster than any planet - a day is only about 10 hours

planets.name: Saturn
planets.description: Famous for its stunning ring system made of ice and rock. Saturn is less dense than water - if there was a bathtub big enough, Saturn would float!
facts: Saturn's rings extend up to 282,000 km from the planet but are only about 10 meters thick
Saturn has the most moons of any planet (146 confirmed)
Winds on Saturn can reach speeds of 1,800 km/h (500 m/s)

planets.name: Uranus
planets.description: An ice giant that rotates on its side, rolling around the Sun. Its blue-green color comes from methane in its atmosphere absorbing red light.
facts: Uranus rotates on its side, with its axis tilted 98 degrees
It's the coldest planetary atmosphere in the solar system at -224°C
Uranus was the first planet discovered using a telescope (1781)

planets.name: Neptune
planets.description: The windiest planet with storms larger than Earth. Neptune was discovered through mathematical predictions before being observed.
facts: Winds on Neptune can reach 2,100 km/h - the fastest in the solar system
Neptune was discovered purely through mathematical calculations in 1846
It takes 165 years for Neptune to complete one orbit around the Sun
